notes: The marginal note 'Or, a word' at dābār was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

ʿal-kēn is a compound of function morphemes whose one English word writes no morpheme's lexeme, so rule 6's deterministic first-token anchor stands; lipnê by contrast heads on its construct noun under rules 30 and 23.
'and thou upon earth' gaps the copula and the ASV writes none, so only 'upon' is placed on the second prepositional predicate (rules 34, 49).
